speaker: COACH
originalText: With one attack, the Hono can finish Hi, Hono, Kagari, Radi, Umeme, Kimubunga, Sjor, Göl, Gölge, Karanlık, Muju, Sachita, Sachakuna, Yan and Mazask. Every unlit card survives that single hit.
speechText: With one attack, the hohnoh can finish Hee, hohnoh, kah-GAH-ree, RAH-dee, oo-MEH-meh, kee-moo-BOON-gah, Shore, Gurl, GURL-geh, kah-rahn-luk, Moo-joo, sah-CHEE-tah, sah-chah-KOO-nah, Yahn and MAH-zahsk. Every unlit card survives that single hit.
